import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Polygon, FancyArrowPatch import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "stix", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" TERRACOTTA = "#C66B4E" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786"
# Illustrative geometric vectors, not measured data. # The cross product is calculated exactly from the displayed construction. a = np.array([1.6, 0.0, 0.0]) b = np.array([-0.35, 1.5, 0.0]) c = np.cross(a, b) origin = np.zeros(3)
assert np.isclose(np.dot(c, a), 0.0) assert np.isclose(np.dot(c, b), 0.0)
# An orthographic camera: right and up are orthonormal screen directions. screen_right = np.array([0.8, -0.6, 0.0]) screen_up = np.array([-0.3, -0.4, np.sqrt(0.75)]) projection = np.vstack([screen_right, screen_up])
def project(points): return np.asarray(points) @ projection.T
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 6), facecolor="white") ax = fig.add_axes([0.055, 0.125, 0.89, 0.76]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.8, 1.85) ax.set_ylim(-1.25, 2.45) ax.axis("off")
fig.text( 0.5, 0.945, "Cross-product orthogonality", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=18, fontweight="medium", )
plane = project([origin, a, a + b, b]) ax.add_patch(Polygon( plane, closed=True, facecolor=TEAL, alpha=0.10, edgecolor="none", zorder=1, ))
# Only the two far edges need auxiliary outlines; the near edges are vectors. far_edges = project([a, a + b, b]) ax.plot( far_edges[:, 0], far_edges[:, 1], color=SLATE, alpha=0.55, linewidth=1.2, zorder=2, )
def draw_vector(vector, color): tip = project(vector) arrow = FancyArrowPatch( (0.0, 0.0), tuple(tip), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=19, linewidth=2.6, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=5, ) ax.add_patch(arrow) return tip
pa = draw_vector(a, BLUE) pb = draw_vector(b, TEAL) pc = draw_vector(c, TERRACOTTA)
# Each square is constructed in its actual 3D perpendicular-vector plane. # Its orthographic image is intentionally foreshortened. uc = c / np.linalg.norm(c) square_size = 0.27 for vector in (a, b): uv = vector / np.linalg.norm(vector) square = project([ square_size * uv, square_size * (uv + uc), square_size * uc, ]) ax.plot( square[:, 0], square[:, 1], color=INK, linewidth=1.45, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=7, path_effects=[ pe.Stroke(linewidth=3.4, foreground="white"), pe.Normal(), ], )
ax.scatter([0], [0], s=22, color=INK, zorder=8)
ax.text( pa[0] + 0.075, pa[1] - 0.025, r"$\mathbf{a}$", color=BLUE, fontsize=24, ha="left", va="center", ) ax.text( pb[0] - 0.085, pb[1] - 0.025, r"$\mathbf{b}$", color=TEAL, fontsize=24, ha="right", va="center", ) ax.text( pc[0] + 0.14, pc[1] - 0.06, r"$\mathbf{c}=\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b}$", color=TERRACOTTA, fontsize=22, ha="left", va="center", ) ax.text( 0.0, -0.19, r"$O$", fontsize=17, ha="center", va="center", bbox={"facecolor": "white", "edgecolor": "none", "pad": 1.0}, zorder=9, )
ax.text( 0.40, 0.16, r"$90^{\circ}$", fontsize=14, ha="left", va="center", color=INK, ) ax.text( -0.40, 0.15, r"$90^{\circ}$", fontsize=14, ha="right", va="center", color=INK, )
plane_center = project((a + b) * 0.55) ax.text( plane_center[0], plane_center[1] - 0.09, "Spanned plane", fontsize=11, color=SLATE, ha="center", va="center", zorder=3, )
fig.text( 0.5, 0.072, r"$\mathbf{c}\cdot\mathbf{a}=0\qquad" r"\mathbf{c}\cdot\mathbf{b}=0$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=20, color=INK, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.025, "Schematic orthographic view", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color=SLATE, )
